title: Can Latent Reasoning Drive LLM Outputs Without a Trace?
author: Tomer Ashuach, Zorik Gekhman, Avi Caciularu, Ori Ram et al.

summary: LLMs typically solve complex tasks with chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, which is also the main tool for monitoring them for misaligned behavior. However, standard transformers can also solve tasks with complete latent reasoning (CLR), carrying out the whole task internally and outputting only the final answer.
takeaways: However, standard transformers can also solve tasks with complete latent reasoning (CLR), carrying out the whole task internally and outputting only the final answer.
In this work, we ask whether CLR is deep enough for a model to pursue a hidden objective that requires reasoning.
Then, in two common tasks, decision-making and code generation, we train a model to pursue such a hidden objective, which decides a loan or plants a vulnerability.
